meta.name: implementing-api-gateway-security-controls
meta.description: Implements security controls at the API gateway layer including authentication enforcement, rate limiting, request validation, IP allowlisting, TLS termination, and threat protection. The engineer configures API gateways (Kong, AWS API Gateway, Azure APIM, Apigee) to act as a centralized security enforcement point that validates, throttles, and monitors all API traffic before it reaches backend services. Activates for requests involving API gateway security, API management security, gateway authentication, or centralized API protection.

copy.tagline: 集中实施API网关安全控制，自动防护后端服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责API网关的安全配置与威胁防护
copy.tagline_en: Centralize security controls at the API gateway to protect backend services

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 会帮你配置 API 网关的安全控制，包括设置认证方式、限制访问频率、验证请求格式、IP 白名单、TLS 加密和威胁防护。它提供具体的配置代码和步骤。
howto.when: 当你提到 API 网关安全、认证、限流、IP 白名单，或者要求配置 Kong、AWS API Gateway 等网关的安全规则时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 Kong 给用户服务配置 JWT 认证和每分钟 60 次的限流。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应的 YAML 配置。

say.text: 在 AWS API Gateway 上启用 mTLS 并关联 WAF 规则。
say.note: Claude 会提供 Python 脚本和配置步骤。

say.text: 给内部管理端 API 添加 IP 白名单，只允许 10.0.0.0/8 网段。
say.note: Claude 会给出 IP 限制配置。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude will help you configure API gateway security controls, including authentication enforcement, rate limiting, request validation, IP allowlisting, TLS termination, and threat protection. It provides specific configuration code and steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention API gateway security, authentication, rate limiting, IP allowlisting, or ask to configure security rules for Kong, AWS API Gateway, etc.

say_en.text: Enable mTLS and attach WAF rules on AWS API Gateway.
say_en.note: Claude will provide Python scripts and steps.

say_en.text: Add IP allowlisting for the admin API to only allow 10.0.0.0/8.
say_en.note: Claude will give the IP restriction config.
